name: Incremental CONfidence (ICON)
definition: ICON is an optimization procedure for training NeRFs from 2D video frames that removes the requirement for pose initialization by assuming smooth camera motion to estimate initial pose guesses and using a 'confidence' measure to dynamically reweight gradients.
summary: Incremental CONfidence (ICON) is a NeRF training method that eliminates initial camera pose estimation by using a Neural Confidence Field to dynamically reweight gradients for joint pose and model optimization.
